This moss is found chiefly in mild temperate climates, especially in deciduous or mixed forests.

Even in suitable terrain, it remains fairly easy to find.

To obtain its properties, it must be prepared as an infusion or decoction.

This moss can preserve organic matter up to the size of a human body for about one day.

Repeated doses can lead to significant dependence.
